floor_history.headline: Recon: honest floor lowered 5->4 CHEAT-FREE (pin removed; sanctioned do-while fences the sll/lw hoist); residual mapped to a single global.c first-free outcome (arg0 ptr homed a1 vs target a3) with .g

Structural sweep (24 variants): floor holds at 4; v07 staged-load form flipped ptr a1->a2 (first movement ever, .greg-proven conflict injection), and the geometry space is now closed — numeric alloc o

frontier.hypothesis: A permuter-discoverable true-C form flips the pointer home to a3
frontier.mechanism: random/directed mutation can surface statement geometries creating a1+a2 conflicts that the now-closed manual geometry space missed (search must move BEYOND tail geometry: loop-region and whole-function shapes)
frontier.next_probe: permuter campaign seeded from candidate.c with PERM variants on loop spelling + tail temp introduction; wait + harvest in-session

frontier.hypothesis: GCC 2.7.2 has a mechanism recording a1/a2 conflicts for pseudos that emit no bytes (REG_EQUIV-folded, reload-inherited, or subreg/DImode paired regs)
frontier.mechanism: conflict lists are built in global.c global_conflicts before final deletions; a pseudo whose uses all fold away post-RA could still have shaped the scan
frontier.next_probe: read global.c/local-alloc.c/reload for zero-byte conflict sources; BB2_ALLOC_DEBUG dumps over candidate shapes exercising REG_EQUIV consts and s64 temps, checking 72's conflict set

frontier.hypothesis: A loop-region respelling (same emitted lui/addu/lbu loop bytes, different pseudo census) supplies the invisible a1/a2 occupants
frontier.mechanism: occupants need not live in the tail — any pseudo overlapping ptr's whole range counts; the s1 park swept tail forms pre-wrap, not loop-region pseudo-census variants on the floor-4 base
frontier.next_probe: sweep loop spellings on top of the floor-4 base (index+temp hybrids, u8* walker with explicit index reload, split flag-read temps) verifying loop bytes unchanged, then check .greg conflicts
